description: The Open Textbook Library (University of Minnesota / Open Education Network) is a catalog of peer-reviewed open educational resource textbooks for higher education. It documents a public read-only JSON API: append .json to textbook and subject resource URLs (and related paths) for programmatic metadata access; OpenAPI docs are published at /opentextbooks/api-docs. CSV and MARC downloads are also provided.
resolution_notes: base_url: corrected — original https://open.umn.edu/opentextbooks/api returns HTTP 404; official discovery docs say request the .json extension on library paths under https://open.umn.edu/opentextbooks (https://open.umn.edu/opentextbooks/discovery). auth_type: keep none — API is public programmatic read access with no key/token required (https://open.umn.edu/opentextbooks/api-docs/index.html; discovery page). example: corrected — /api/v1/textbooks?search=calculus returns 404; working pattern is textbooks.json?q=... (live curl 2026-08-08). description: corrected — site is an OER catalog AND documents a public JSON API via .json extension and Swagger/OpenAPI at api-docs; Verifier B overstated “no API,” but original overstated a /api base and invented v1 paths.
